The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 09.08.2023 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Gauharganj, District Raisen in Special Case No.123 of 2020, whereby the learned trial Court has convicted and sentenced the appellant as under:

 363 I.P.C. R.I. for 3 years Rs.1,000/-

sentences.text: Shri Sharad Singh Baghel, learned counsel for the appellant submits that there are general and omnibus allegations against the present appellant Vimal, which are not medically corroborated.
The main accused is Ram Prasad.

It is also submitted that co-accused Sunil has been extended benefit of suspension of sentenced by this Court vide order dated 25.11.2025 passed in Criminal Appeal No.14499/2023 and the case of the present appellant is on similar footing.
It is further submitted that there are good chances of success in the appeal.
Hence, 2 CRA-13458-2023 prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release them on bail on the ground of parity.

sentences.text: Ms. Shweta Yadav, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State, in his turn, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also looking to the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case,
we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail on the ground of parity.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for their appearance before the trial Court on 30.04.2026 and on such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon appellant Vimal Singh shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.28268/2023 is allowed & disposed of.
List the case for final hearing in Part-B of the cause list as per its turn and seniority.
Certified copy as per rules.
 (VIVEK AGARWAL) (RATNESH CHANDRA S  JUDGE JUDGE
